Hi Laura / Tom,

Thanks again for the interest in running a focused POC with Redwood. We'd like to schedule a two-hour hands-on kickoff that combines:
- a short product demo (15-20m) tailored to your prompts/routing use cases,
- a prompt review and routing configuration walkthrough, and
- an initial load-testing/benchmark run to validate throughput & latency targets.

Proposed slots (PT):
1) Tue Jan 20 — 10:00–12:00
2) Wed Jan 21 — 09:00–11:00
3) Thu Jan 22 — 08:30–10:30

Please let me know which of those works for your team (or suggest alternatives). Two quick asks ahead of the session:
- Confirm a target throughput and SLO we should validate during the run (e.g., 200 rps, 95th <200ms).
- Share any representative prompt sets or traffic shapes we should preload.

I'm attaching a short draft test-plan for visibility (GB_POCTestPlan_v0.1.pdf) and a spec for the harness we typically use (load_harness_spec.yaml). We can also share a repo link if you prefer to run from your side.

Cc'd Marissa and Aisha from my team — they'll run the load harness and coordinate infra/credentials.

Best,
Connor
